method: Paired real native-model discovery sessions on copies of original wave-32 apps, using the exact wave-33 day-two briefs/backend instructions, ending at an implementation/proof plan. No app implementation, deploy, production accounts, frontend build or full day-two score. Same model CLIs/flags as run-bakeoff.mjs. Docs are o200k_base tokens from actual tool-visible package/guide/init outputs; batched surrounding output is conservatively included. Raw CLI stdout is an independent cross-check, not substituted for tool-visible bytes. Native total/cached/uncached input, calls and wall include provider waits and concurrent host load.
baseline: Retained original 0.4.44 client/platform tarballs from ~/sb4-loop/dist/0.4.44; after uses installed candidate tarballs. README/card/digest bytes and artifact hashes are recorded. Whole-wave input means are contextual and not paired full-app comparisons.
